prompt: Write a C# implementation of an LRU cache. Explain the time complexity of each operation.
hardware: Threadripper PRO 5955WX, 128 GB RAM, three RTX 3090 24 GB, Windows

llamampere.metric: API timings.predicted_per_second; arithmetic mean of completed measured requests
llamampere.flash_mtp: jakeatx mtp-Swift-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-Q2S-B.gguf, adaptive depth 3..4, p-min 0, expert skipping off
llamampere.native_dense_ai4_exception: Swift1.5 Uncensored fine-tuned weights; SJ-KVaRN4 KV; built-in adaptive MTP; separate cohort
llamampere.full_answer_thinking_reservation: At max_tokens 8192, default answer reserve can close thinking at 6144; short probes can close thinking at 256 of 512
llamampere.context_fallback: Reduced only after OOM. See each row for actual context.
llamampere.repetitions: Actual count recorded per row. Latest six dense full-answer cases: two measured requests, all natural stops.
llamampere.mode_biased_mtp: Default enabled; no --no-spec-mb-mtp override in the recorded controlled configurations

clock_experiment.phases: Automatic n=2; locked n=2; automatic return n=1. Same loaded model. Completion lengths differ.

limits: Single prompt, small repetition counts, no systematic answer-quality or code-correctness evaluation
Reasoning and answer tokens both count toward generated tokens
Context capacity is not actual prompt occupancy
Observed min-max ranges are not confidence intervals
Some exploratory earlier rows used different conditions; read workbook Methodology before comparing
Failures and timeouts have no completed throughput value; they are not zero-speed results
